card.title: Back My Version
card.instruction: Recruit someone to remember, repeat, and defend one shared version of events when questions begin.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The caretaker's asking about our extra key. Tell him we were checking the cake cupboard's lock.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We did check it. Then we ate the cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Start with the part we both remember as maintenance.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He'll ask why there are crumbs in the lock.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we both remember a blockage. Say that back so we're consistent.

mechanism: A trains B to repeat a maintenance account that absorbs incriminating cake evidence into their shared story.
confusable: Unlike vague concealment, A must demand consistent repetition of the same agreed account.
comparison: Rehearsing blockage converts crumbs to maintenance evidence; the greenhouse scene negotiates truthful sequence instead.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
